items.title: Ford and Stellantis Make Brilliant Moves to Gain Market Share. Is It Too Little, Too Late?
items.summary: The automotive industry has had an allergic reaction to producing smaller, more affordable vehicles over the past decade, but with pent-up demand for them, the time might be perfect to strike.

items.title: General Motors Dumps Another Major EV Battery Stake; GM Stock Rises
items.summary: General Motors will sell its stake in an Indiana EV battery plant to South Korea's Samsung SDI amid sluggish demand for electric cars. GM stock offered a trendline entry on Tuesday. Ford stock and Tesla stock also gained below key levels.

items.title: How to Deploy $1000 Across Tesla and Ford for Growth and Optionality
items.summary: Tesla is burning cash on robotaxis and Optimus while Ford prints it with trucks and software subscriptions, and splitting a thousand dollars between them means choosing how much disruption risk you can actually stomach.

items.title: Goodyear Q2 Earnings Miss Expectations on Volume Pressure

items.title: Tesla Stock's Deepest Fall Was Worse Than Its Worst Market Crash
items.summary: The market shocks in its record, stop short of the deepest drop in its own price history, and over the last twelve months the market climbed while the stock barely moved.

items.title: Ford’s (F) $28,350 Electric Pickup Bet Meets A Cheap Stock
